neighbours.label: the word-internal piece 'id' / 'idi' when it follows a piece ending in r (Mer|id|ional, plur|id|isciplinary, Far|idi, tr|idi|agonal, Eur|id|ice); '-id' endings and 'idian' stay quiet
fire: My uncle read the Meridional every morning with his coffee.
Our flight home on Meridiana was delayed by three hours.
The clinic offers pluridisciplinary care for patients with chronic pain.
The cricket fans cheered when Afridi walked out to bat.
A lecture by Professor Faridi opened the conference on Monday.
The philosopher Floridi has written widely about the ethics of information.
The algorithm reduces the system to a tridiagonal form in two passes.
In the opera, Euridice dies a second time when Orfeo turns round.
quiet: My uncle read the Guardian every morning with his coffee.
Our flight home across the meridian was delayed by three hours.
The clinic offers rapid and candid advice for patients with chronic pain.
The cricket fans cheered when David walked out to bat.
A lecture by Professor Hamid opened the conference on Monday.
The Floridian writer has written widely about the humid climate of the coast.
The algorithm reduces the system to a valid solid form in two passes.
In the opera, the timid hero dies a second time beside the pyramid.

notes: spelling-unit pole: it fires only where the tokenizer makes 'id'/'idi' its own piece (meridian and Floridian split as 'idian' and scored about 0.1).
